operations.name: read_codec_id
operations.desc: Read AC97 codec vendor/device ID via NAM BAR0
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xC07C
in ax, dx
ret

operations.name: read_master_volume
operations.desc: Read AC97 master volume register via NAM BAR0
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xC002
in ax, dx
ret
operations.returns: Master volume in AX (bits 5:0 = right, bits 13:8 = left, bit 15 = mute)
